residualAssumptions: Directories named .git, .excavator, node_modules, vendor, dist, build and files whose name ends in _test.go or contains .test. or .spec. are not scanned; an entrypoint in them is not listed.
Files over 2097152 bytes and files with a NUL byte are not scanned; they are counted under files.skipped.
A pattern matches one line, or the line and the next one for the entries the catalog marks "lines": 2 (express routes); a registration spread over more lines is not listed.
One candidate per line: a line that patterns of two frameworks match is credited to the framework listed first in the catalog.
Under react and react-router, route objects (path:) are listed only in files whose path contains "router", and under react <Route> elements too; a route declared in another file is not listed.
No knowledge graph: frameworks were detected from the build files, by the detector /excavator uses and the catalog's own rules.
